notes.title: Boxfight Release - Fall Update
notes.content:
Boxfight release - Fall Update !

Dear Boxfighters, it's a pleasure to announce you the Fall Update content, hope you will enjoy !

Repulse Game mode

A new dangerous arena, if you touch the electrical wall you loose ! Each Boxfighter can repulse them opponent thanks to their Repulsor weapon. A jetpack allows you to fly and avoid to die instantly, master it and you will be the champion !

New character

A new challenger was appeared, all loves pumpkins but with him it's not reciprocal ... only the victory is counting that's why he comes to arena D1 !
